data.one_liner: Wrap around existing widgets to animate a border line for loading states or colorful borders.
data.what_it_does: It provides a widget wrapper that animates a border line around any existing widget. It supports controllers to start, stop, or freeze the animation, along with gradient colors, border radius, and padding controls.
use_when: You want to indicate a loading state with an animated border around a widget.
You need a colorful gradient border with custom thickness and radius.
avoid_when: You need standard physics-based motion or complex timeline sequencing.
You need support for custom non-rectangular container shapes.
strengths: Includes a controller to start, stop, and freeze the border animation.
Supports gradients, custom border radius, and thickness controls.
weaknesses: Does not yet support custom container shapes.
Upcoming features like progress bar support are not yet implemented.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a comprehensive general-purpose animation library for widgets.

data.minimal_example:
AnimateBorder(
  controller: _controller,
  child: Container(
    padding: EdgeInsets.all(16),
    child: Text('Loading State'),
  ),
)
